items.title: Allen Toussaint Interview, 1979-03-13
items.q: Well, in a way the same for Irma Thomas, but there are some songs that I wrote for Irma that sound quite normal to me as a normal song.

ctx.x: You had to leave minute records for the Army. What happened? Were you drafted in 1963?

Right. That must have really disrupted things. A bit, yes. I was, by that time I was ready to go to the Army. I had been deferred a couple of times before then. And one time I was out because my left foot was in a cast from putting on trampoline shows. I had an accident. But I had been deferred a couple of times. So by January of 63, I didn't mind going to Army. A lot of artists did leave and ventured to other places. Of course, it was a blessing for some, seemingly. The first actual million seller that Irma had…
And you just heard it on the radio while you were probably on the case.
